'''Brassk's Trandoshani Flatcakes''' was a company active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that sold [[Flatcake/Legends|flatcakes]], claiming that they were the only flatcakes served with authentic [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] fruit. The company sponsored [[Huttball/Legends|Huttball]] matches.
